title: land and merge read the request and merge it through bl_forge, with one project and one read per pass
goal: bl_land.py runs no glab itself: the request read of land's rerun, the description PUT of describe_merge_request and merge's view, list and merge all go through bl_forge with the one forge_project (forge_project set: every call names it); a land pass reads the request state once and reuses it; land --wait-merge sleeps and re-reads at its long interval, no loop a session writes

run: import sys; sys.exit(1 if '"glab"' in open('_tools/bl_land.py', encoding='utf-8').read() else 0)

leave bl_forge.py alone and drop the description PUT from this item (it stays a glab call in bl_land.py, so the item's second check cannot pass and the story's third check waits on a new task)

gates.answer: widen the item's touches by _tools/bl_forge.py: Request gains description, both arms gain set_description (the gh arm refuses like its merge), bl_land.describe_merge_request goes through it

gates.question: At what interval, and by what read, does land --wait-merge re-read while it waits for the code/<id> merge request?
options: every 60 s (WAIT_POLL) by a git fetch of the integration main, the forge read once per pass

every 60 s by a bl_forge read of the request as well as the fetch
